scope: Retrospective sensitivity designed after inspecting raw-transfer failures and hyperparameter-boundary selection. This is neither a blind test nor a new confirmatory experiment. The finite expanded grids and both representations are retained. Select each source family/group/representation on 2020–2021 seven-day RMSE only; fit coefficients and all climatologies/scales on 2010–2019 targets. Seasonal-anomaly transfer uses destination training climatology and residual scales, together with destination origin histories, but unchanged source increment coefficients and feature scaler. Destination-local fits use source-selected hyperparameters. Every group, lead, year and context is reported, including deterioration. New block intervals are pointwise descriptive sensitivities, with no new confirmatory p values. Original frozen protocols, forecasts and all prior process-transfer results remain unchanged.
